REZ.summary: No material Renzo news in the last week; buybacks remain paused and over 95% of supply already circulates. Next listed insider release (80M REZ) is Nov 28, outside the 14-day window.

MORPHO.summary: Adoption keeps building (USDG lending on Arbitrum ~$143M in under a month, RDUSD stablecoin plans on HSK Chain, RWA deposits above $2B), which backs the long. No dated unlock from a reliable source in the next 14 days; DropsTab shows only small undated monthly founder/partner vesting (~0.04% of circulating).

news.title: USDG lending on Morpho (Arbitrum) reaches ~$143M in under a month
HashKey and RD Technologies plan RDUSD stablecoin on HSK Chain, exploring Morpho lending
Morpho's real-world-asset markets pass $2B in deposits with about $894M in loans outstanding

SKY.summary: Governance raised the sUSDS savings rate to 3.80% from protocol surplus and passed routine Atlas edits, on top of the Q3 report's rising revenue and ongoing buybacks and burns. SKY is essentially fully unlocked, so no unlocks in the next 14 days.

news.title: Sky governance lifts the sUSDS savings rate to 3.80%, funded by protocol surplus
Weekly Atlas edit passes: 900K USDS Skybase grant, Spark PAU on Base, higher Gauntlet vault cap
Sky Q3 report: net revenue $37.2M (sixth straight positive quarter), $5.6M of SKY buybacks

POL.summary: Polygon's fee burns (100M POL burned, 22M more queued) and rising usage (weekly DEX volume +32% to $740M, stablecoins ~$2.9B) work against the short, though POL still trades near $0.09 below its 200-day average. No vesting unlocks; only the regular yearly emission.

news.title: Polygon PoS weekly DEX volume up 32% to ~$740M; stablecoin supply ~$2.9B
Polygon brings US banking access to Solana's stablecoin market
POL jumps ~12% after a 100M POL fee burn and product upgrades

DOT.summary: No new Polkadot catalyst: DOT holds just above ~$0.91 support below all key averages, long liquidations dominate and funding is negative with crowded retail longs. CoinShares' Polkadot staking ETP is still set for redemption around Nov 9. No vesting unlocks.

news.title: DOT near $0.94 as ~93% of liquidations hit longs; price clings to ~$0.91 support
DOT down ~21% in 30 days; ~70% of OKX accounts long while funding turns negative
DOT falls ~10% in a day to about $0.91 on Oct 29, with no single cause reported

ZK.summary: An investor and team unlock of about 173M ZK (roughly 1.5% of circulating supply) lands Nov 17, adding supply that favours the short. Risk to the short: ZKsync teased upcoming ZK token news on Oct 28 with no details yet.

news.title: ZKsync teases upcoming ZK token announcement after Prividium Commander launch

AIXBT.label: bearish
AIXBT.about: aixbt is an autonomous AI agent launched on Virtuals Protocol that tracks crypto social chatter and market data and posts market intelligence. Holding AIXBT gives access to its premium analytics terminal.
AIXBT.summary: No price-moving news in the past week and supply is fully unlocked, so no new supply pressure. Liquidity stays thin after Binance removed margin and a spot pair in September.

TRUMP.label: bearish
TRUMP.about: Official Trump is a Solana memecoin tied to Donald Trump; Trump-linked entities hold about 80% of supply under multi-year vesting. It has no utility beyond speculation and holder perks such as dinner events.
TRUMP.summary: The post-midterm drop and an insider unlock listed for Nov 18 lean toward the short; a holder-dinner snapshot on Nov 12 could support holding demand until then.

news.title: TRUMP falls about 17% after the Democratic midterm sweep hits Trump-linked assets

unlocks.note: Monthly insider unlock (2.9% of total supply, ~3.7% of market cap); one source only, DropsTab models it as daily linear vesting

DASH.label: bullish
DASH.about: Dash is a proof-of-work digital cash coin with masternodes, instant transactions and optional mixing, plus the Evolution app platform. DASH is used for payments, fees and masternode collateral.
DASH.summary: The v24 release and signaling from Nov 9 set up a dated catalyst (shared masternodes around Nov 28) that supports the long, while the EU privacy-coin rules from 2027 remain a drag. Mined coin with no unlocks.

news.title: Dash Core v24.0.0 released; every node must upgrade ahead of the masternode-shares hard fork
v24 hard fork targeted for about Nov 28 lets users pool the 1,000 DASH masternode collateral; signaling begins Nov 9
Privacy coins sell off and DASH slips to about $46 on worries over the EU privacy-coin ban

ZEC.label: bullish
ZEC.about: Zcash is a privacy-focused proof-of-work cryptocurrency that supports shielded (encrypted) transactions using zero-knowledge proofs. ZEC is used for payments and paying fees, and is mined with a fixed 21M supply cap.
ZEC.summary: NU7 activated cleanly and ZEC held up better than the market, which fits the long, but outflows from the Grayscale ETF show some sell-the-news selling. Mined coin, so there are no vesting unlocks.

news.title: NU7 goes live on Nov 6 with 25-second blocks and a fee reserve; ZEC rises while the wider market falls
Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) has about $11M of outflows around the NU7 activation, reversing an earlier inflow
Zcash Community Grants drops its 98,000 ZEC funding proposal after community pushback

XMR.label: bullish
XMR.about: Monero is a privacy-focused proof-of-work cryptocurrency where sender, receiver and amount are hidden by default. XMR is used for private payments and has a small perpetual tail emission.
XMR.summary: XMR keeps holding up better than other privacy coins, with about $600 as the support level analysts are watching and a new perp listing. Hack funds flowing into XMR add delisting and regulatory headline risk. Mined coin with no unlocks.

news.title: Credit Mutuel Arkea confirms a cyberattack costing $133M+; ZachXBT traces part of the stolen funds into XMR
Decibel adds XMR perpetual futures on Aptos with up to 5x leverage
Mercado Bitcoin confirms a $38M breach; the stolen funds are routed into XMR

VVV.label: bullish
VVV.about: Venice is a privacy-first AI platform offering private, uncensored access to text, image and code models via app and API. Staking VVV gives a share of free API inference capacity, and part of supply is burned.
VVV.summary: The Valour exchange-traded product widens access a little, but recent moves mostly track the wider altcoin market. No dated cliff unlock in the window, only ongoing linear emissions (recently cut to about 2M VVV a year) offset by buy-and-burn.

news.title: Valour lists a Venice (VVV) exchange-traded product on Sweden's Spotlight Stock Market
VVV rises about 17% as DeFi tokens rally after the US midterms

LIT.label: bullish
LIT.about: Lighter is a perpetual-futures DEX built on an Ethereum zk-rollup with verifiable order matching, also offering stock perps. LIT is its native token, used for governance and staking, with protocol revenue funding buybacks.
LIT.summary: The pending CFTC filing, the new single-stock perp rules and ongoing buyback-and-burn support the long, while the 3.9M LIT sent to exchanges is the near-term supply risk. No unlock in the window: the team and investor cliff (500M LIT) starts Dec 27.

news.title: CFTC allows registered exchanges to list single-stock perpetual futures; Lighter is among the venues that could apply
Lighter opens perps on Turkey's 30 largest stocks; one wallet unstakes 3.9M LIT and sends it to exchanges
LIT gains about 16% as Lighter confirms its CFTC DCM and DCO licence filings for November

PUMP.label: bullish
PUMP.about: Pump.fun is a Solana launchpad and trading platform for memecoins. PUMP is its native token, and the protocol uses part of its revenue to buy back and burn PUMP.
PUMP.summary: Weekly buybacks (~$5M) continue, but about 9B PUMP from the monthly team/investor unlock lands Nov 12, and Pump.fun is still sending SOL to Kraken. Together they add supply pressure against the long.

news.title: Pump.fun brings in about $56M in 30-day revenue and has spent about $414M on PUMP buybacks and burns in 2026
Pump.fun moves 76,111 SOL (~$6.9M) to Kraken during a market-wide sell-off
About $5M of PUMP bought back and burned over the past week

unlocks.note: Monthly linear release to team/insiders (~61%) and existing investors (~39%), about 0.9% of total supply. DropsTab shows ~8.96B PUMP (about 1.95% of circulating) for the next tranche but gives no date

HYPE.label: bullish
HYPE.about: Hyperliquid is a layer-1 chain built around an on-chain perpetual futures and spot exchange. HYPE pays gas, is staked for security and to deploy HIP-3 markets, and receives buybacks from trading fees.
HYPE.summary: The PURR FCM filing helps the US-access story for the long, but whale profit-taking and the market-wide drop to about $77 work against it. The Nov 6 core-contributor unlock was small and already happened; nothing else is scheduled before the next monthly unlock in early December.

news.title: Hyperliquid Strategies (PURR) applies for CFTC futures commission merchant status and posts Q3 results
HYPE falls about 8% to near $77 in a broad sell-off; the monthly team unlock released only 180K HYPE
Santiment: four whale wallets lock in about $5M of HYPE profit as price falls 12% from the late-October peak

FOGO.label: bearish
FOGO.about: Fogo is a Solana-VM-compatible Layer-1 built for low-latency on-chain trading. FOGO pays gas, is staked to secure the network and funds ecosystem incentives.
FOGO.summary: Bitget's spot delisting took effect Nov 6, cutting liquidity, and a 171.5M FOGO insider/investor unlock (about 4.3% of market cap) is due around Nov 15. Both fit the short.

news.title: Bitget delisting of the FOGO/USDT spot pair takes effect

unlocks.note: Insiders (~66%) and private investors (~34%): core contributors, institutional investors, Echo raise, advisors; about 1.7% of total supply and 4.3% of market cap per tracker

KAITO.label: bearish
KAITO.about: Kaito is an AI-driven crypto research and InfoFi platform that ranks social attention and links brands with creators. KAITO is used for staking, governance and access to platform rewards.
KAITO.summary: No KAITO-specific news since Nov 1. The Nov 20 monthly unlock of about 27.2M KAITO (about 5.4% of market cap) adds supply, which fits the short.

unlocks.note: Monthly unlock (~$5.7M, 2.7% of total supply, 5.4% of market cap): community/ecosystem growth ~61.5%, core contributors ~25.6%, early backers ~8.5%, foundation ~4.5%. Tokenomist confirms the Nov 20 date and recipients but hides the amount

SOPH.label: bearish
SOPH.about: Sophon was a consumer-focused Ethereum L2 built on ZKsync tech that is shutting its chain to focus on apps on Base. SOPH was its gas, staking and governance token and is migrating to an Ethereum ERC-20.
SOPH.summary: The chain wind-down is on schedule: withdrawals are due by Nov 25 and mainnet closes Nov 30, while CoinDCX futures stay reduce-only. That keeps pressure on SOPH, in line with the short. No dated unlocks.

news.title: Sophon reminds users to withdraw SOPH, ETH and USDC by Nov 25 ahead of the Nov 30 mainnet shutdown

2Z.label: bearish
2Z.about: DoubleZero is a high-performance fiber network for Solana and other chains' validators, aimed at cutting latency and bandwidth costs. 2Z pays for network access and rewards bandwidth contributors.
2Z.summary: The only 2Z item is Binance reopening withdrawals after its hack, which is market plumbing more than a 2Z catalyst. The next unlock (135.4M 2Z, 2.6% of market cap) is Dec 2, outside the window.

news.title: Binance reopens withdrawals for more assets, including 2Z on Solana, as it recovers from its $6.3B breach

BLUR.label: bearish
BLUR.about: Blur is a pro-trader NFT marketplace and aggregator on Ethereum that also ran Blend, a peer-to-peer NFT lending product. BLUR is its governance token and controls the fee switch.
BLUR.summary: Blur's site closes Nov 12 and Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb delist BLUR Nov 30, which cuts both use and liquidity, in line with the short. No dated unlocks found.

HMSTR.label: bearish
HMSTR.about: Hamster Kombat is a tap-to-earn Telegram game on TON that grew from a viral clicker into a wider gaming ecosystem. HMSTR is its token, distributed through player airdrops and used for rewards and in-game activity.
HMSTR.summary: No price-moving HMSTR news this week. Team and partnership tokens vest linearly in tiny daily amounts (about 0.02% of market cap per DropsTab), with no large dated unlock in the window. Price is likely to follow Telegram-game and memecoin sentiment.

JTO.label: bearish
JTO.about: Jito is Solana's largest liquid-staking and MEV infrastructure project (JitoSOL, the Jito block engine and the Block Assembly Marketplace). JTO is its governance token, with JTX platform revenue going to buybacks and burns under JIP-38.
JTO.summary: The Nov 7 unlock (about 17M JTO to insiders and investors) was the last vesting event, and Tokenomics.com lists no more unlocks, so there is no new scheduled supply in the window. Some of the freshly unlocked tokens may still be sold, but the BAM operator and ORE treasury news lean positive, which works against a short.

news.title: ORE and Jito Foundation agree reciprocal treasury holdings; ORE moves part of its SOL into JitoSOL
Jito names Triton One, Bitwise and SOL Strategies as first outside BAM node operators
Solana validator credential attack stole ~$135K and 637 JitoSOL; user stake not directly hit

NXPC.label: bearish
NXPC.about: NEXPACE is Nexon's Web3 arm behind MapleStory Universe, running on the Henesys chain (an Avalanche L1). NXPC is used for item minting and enhancement, marketplace fees and rewards, with 20% of user-activity revenue burned quarterly.
NXPC.summary: A Nov 15 unlock is confirmed by several trackers. The cliff portion to IP MG and the team is small (about 1M NXPC), but up to about 7.9M including Contribution Reward emissions (about 2.4% of market cap) adds supply that favours the short. The Nov 12 Moonbridge update is a possible offset.

news.title: MapleStory Universe launches Moonbridge on Nov 12 and delays the Black Mage boss to Q1 2027

unlocks.note: Foundation/Contribution Reward (~97%) and insiders (~3%) per Tokenomics.com, ~2.4% of market cap. Date confirmed by Tokenomist (Contribution Reward) and CoinGecko, which lists only the 0.99M IP MG + Team cliff portion (0.10% of total supply); the rest is reward emissions

PEOPLE.label: bearish
PEOPLE.about: ConstitutionDAO began as a 2021 crowdfund that tried to buy a first-edition copy of the US Constitution. PEOPLE was its governance token and now trades as a fully circulating community memecoin with no active product.
PEOPLE.summary: No project news or unlocks, and the supply is fully circulating. The US midterms, the political theme traders had pointed to, were decided around Nov 4, so that catalyst has passed. Price trades on memecoin sentiment.

MEME.label: bearish
MEME.about: Memecoin (MEME) is the token of Memeland, the Web3 group behind 9GAG's Captainz and Potatoz NFTs. It openly has no utility or roadmap and is used for community and ecosystem rewards.
MEME.summary: The only news is a small StockFi integration with unproven impact, and no dated unlock falls in Nov 8-22. The short mostly depends on broader memecoin risk appetite.

news.title: BSC platform StockFi plans to use MEME for community incentives around tokenized US stock trading

ME.label: bearish
ME.about: Magic Eden is an NFT and token trading platform that in 2026 closed its Bitcoin and EVM marketplaces to focus on Solana and 'crypto entertainment'. ME is its governance and rewards token, with 15% of platform revenue going to buybacks and staker rewards.
ME.summary: The OKX spot delisting took effect Nov 5 and cut liquidity, and a Nov 10 unlock (at least 6.96M ME, ~1.1% of float) adds supply. Both favour the short; revenue-funded buybacks are the main offset.

news.title: OKX delists ME spot pairs and suspends deposits, effective Nov 5
Magic Eden detail on wallet shutdown and Bitcoin/EVM marketplace exit as it narrows to Solana

unlocks.note: Community & Ecosystem cliff unlock (0.7% of total supply, 1.12% of float per DefiLlama; Tokenomist confirms the Nov 10 date and recipient). Tokenomics.com earlier listed a larger 22.4M total including insiders and investors; that figure could not be re-verified.

BOME.label: bearish
BOME.about: BOOK OF MEME is a Solana memecoin themed around permanently storing meme culture on decentralized storage. BOME has no real utility and trades on speculation and community attention.
BOME.summary: No BOME news since mid-October and the supply is fully circulating, so price tracks memecoin sentiment and leverage flushes.

BERA.label: bearish
BERA.about: Berachain is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 using Proof-of-Liquidity, where validators direct rewards to liquidity providers. BERA is the gas and staking token, while BGT handles governance and reward emissions.
BERA.summary: The Nov 6 monthly unlock (~13.4M BERA) has passed, and trackers show no dated event before early December. No price-moving project news this week, so the short has no fresh catalyst beyond the supply released Nov 6.

XPL.label: bearish
XPL.about: Plasma is an EVM-compatible Layer-1 built for stablecoin payments, offering zero-fee USDT transfers and anchoring to Bitcoin. XPL is the native token used for gas, validator staking and network rewards.
XPL.summary: XPL hit a record low Nov 6 amid manipulation traces and paused Binance withdrawals, which may reopen this week and add sell flow or relieve stuck holders. The next monthly tranche (~227.8M XPL) is Nov 25, just outside the window.

news.title: Binance aims to reopen XPL withdrawals in phases within about a week after its Oct 29 breach; XPL sets a new all-time low
On-chain trace ties wallets behind the Nov 1 XPL liquidation cascade to an April pump-and-dump cluster
TradingBeats follows ~200K USDT from the April XPL cluster to an address in the Nov 1 crash; Hyperliquid HLP absorbed $12M+ of longs

HEMI.label: bearish
HEMI.about: Hemi is a modular Layer-2 that joins Bitcoin and Ethereum, anchoring state to Bitcoin so developers can build BTC DeFi with EVM tools. HEMI pays network fees and is staked as veHEMI for governance and yield.
HEMI.summary: No HEMI news in the past week; the last monthly unlock was Oct 29 and none is dated before Nov 20, so the short leans on chart and market beta. The September exploit and cancelled Upbit listing remain background overhangs.

STABLE.label: bearish
STABLE.about: Stable is a Bitfinex/Tether-backed EVM Layer-1 built for stablecoin payments, using USDT0 as its gas asset. STABLE is the native token used for validator staking, governance and ecosystem incentives. The Hyperliquid STABLE perp launched Dec 8, 2025, alongside this chain's mainnet and token launch.
STABLE.summary: About 888.9M STABLE (~4.9% of circulating supply, ~$23-24M) unlocks for the community/ecosystem allocation on Nov 8, right after a rally that analysts flagged as overextended. That supply leans with the short, though recipients may stake rather than sell.

news.title: Stable activates mainnet v1.9.0 with security hardening and reliability upgrades
RootData flags a ~$23M STABLE unlock due Nov 8

unlocks.note: Community/ecosystem allocation (grants, liquidity, incentives); ~$23.8M, 3.3% of market cap; RootData gives 13:00 Beijing (05:00 UTC). % of circulating is from CMC AI.
